# Attestation Artifact

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:AttestationArtifact`](gmeow-AttestationArtifact.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/AttestationArtifact>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/attestation`](../../slices/attestation.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A concrete carrier of an attestation — in-toto JSON, SLSA provenance, W3C Verifiable [`Credential`](gmeow-Credential.md), DSSE envelope, C2PA manifest, EAT token, signed RDF graph, SCITT signed statement, nanopublication, signed git tag, release manifest, or signed blockchain payload. The artifact is the serialization; the [`Attestation`](gmeow-Attestation.md) is the logical vouching act that the artifact carries.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:AttestationArtifact`](gmeow-AttestationArtifact.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to type the concrete serialized document that embodies an attestation — the on-disk or on-wire bytes (in-toto JSON, DSSE envelope, VC, C2PA manifest) as distinct from the logical vouching act it carries.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the logical vouching act itself (that is [`gmeow:Attestation`](gmeow-Attestation.md)) and for the signature over the bytes ([`gmeow:CryptographicSignature`](gmeow-CryptographicSignature.md)); the artifact is the carrier document, an [`InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md), not the act or the signature.

### How to use

- Mint the carrier as an [`AttestationArtifact`](gmeow-AttestationArtifact.md), set [`gmeow:artifactMediaType`](../properties/gmeow-artifactMediaType.md) and a [`gmeow:contentDigest`](../properties/gmeow-contentDigest.md) for byte-exact identity, link it from the [`Attestation`](gmeow-Attestation.md) with [`gmeow:attestationArtifact`](../properties/gmeow-attestationArtifact.md), and attach its signature with [`gmeow:hasSignature`](../properties/gmeow-hasSignature.md).

### Examples

- ex:inTotoJson a [`gmeow:AttestationArtifact`](gmeow-AttestationArtifact.md); [`gmeow:artifactMediaType`](../properties/gmeow-artifactMediaType.md) "application/vnd.in-toto+json".
